one_liner: Master Report Redirect — all dimensions without Target
description: Main Redirect report (POP + Domain + Commerce Media) with the full set of dimensions. 22 optional filters: publisher, source, advertiser, campaign, category, country, device, OS, browser, carrier, adult, brand, etc. Does NOT include the Target dimension (scaling problem — millions of targets). For deep ad-hoc analysis with arbitrary regrouping.
scope_and_overlap: COVERS ALL Zeropark traffic: POP, DOMAIN and Commerce Media/Search (SEARCH_TILES rows are INCLUDED here). For whole-Zeropark totals or per-traffic-type breakdowns use THIS report ALONE. NEVER add SearchMasterReportRow / SearchTargetMasterReportRow numbers on top — their Search data is already inside this report; summing the two double-counts Search (empirically verified: Search profit came out 2x).

generation_options.filters_usage: Filters are FULLY SUPPORTED at generation time — pass them in generate_zeropark_report; do NOT defer filtering to SQL. Format: filters=[{"name": "<FILTER_NAME>", "values": ["v1", "v2"]}]. Names must come from this schema's filters lists. PUBLISHER_FEED takes publisher_feed_hash values (e.g. 'ibis-leopard'), NOT display names. Filters listed under filters.required accept exactly one value.

time_aggregation.note: With 'BY_HOUR' or 'BY_DAY' and BY_MONTH a time column is ADDED AUTOMATICALLY to the report — do not put it in dimensions. These are the ONLY valid values; there is no week aggregation. Use BY_HOUR aggregation only if directly asked for; it is not a good idea for large reports

generation_options.dates: date_from/date_to use 'YYYY-MM-DD HH' (hour precision, UTC). date_to is an EXCLUSIVE end boundary (a point in time): to cover a full day X, end at the NEXT day's 00. Yesterday = '2026-08-02 00' -> '2026-08-03 00'; last 7 full days = '2026-07-27 00' -> '2026-08-03 00'. Ending at 'X 23' drops the 23:00-23:59 hour — never do that for whole-day ranges.
